ui_guidance: Follow the supplied app design, wordmark, mascot, fonts and palette. Composite controlled UI layers. Supplied reference screens contain AI-generated badges; these must not appear in the commercial's screen compositions. Use The idea / The result for the comparison.

crime_meter.label: Weirdness level / Food Felony
crime_meter.distinction: Creation setting is 100/100. The source recipe's database Crime Level is 92/100; do not rewrite that stored score.

continuity: One fictional main cook with consistent clothes and kitchen. Three featured fictional community cooks appear first among the nine reactors, then in their own distinct kitchens with the same dish, then as the owners of three distinct staged result photos. Preserve Commercial dramatization disclosure, without AI labels.
cost_note: 22 seconds of planned 1080p Seedance footage plus 3 seconds of brand graphics. Previous total estimate was 352 credits; recheck the revised 6/5/4/7-second allocation before generation.

flow.title: Maximum crime
flow.visual: Thumb slides the app's Weirdness / Food Felony meter to 100/100. Red pulse, bass hit. No prompt typing.

flow.title: Reveal, grin and ingredients
flow.visual: Dish image appears on the phone, cut to the main cook's mischievous grin, then quick ingredient reveals on the counter.

flow.title: The original cook
flow.visual: Same main person chops, whisks, pours into a ring mold, then unmolds the wobbling completed dish after a visible time jump.

flow.title: Compare and share
flow.visual: The idea beside The result: exact polished concept and original database photo as staged example. Main cook taps Share; paired post appears in a fictional feed.

flow.title: Nine people react
flow.visual: A nine-person grid fills with surprise, laughter and delight. Three of these people become the featured community cooks in the next beat.

flow.title: The challenge spreads
flow.visual: Three reaction cells expand into three separate home kitchens. Those same people actively recreate the vegetable gelatin: mixing, pouring or unmolding. Distinct plates and slightly different homemade finishes keep the attempts individual.

flow.title: Upload their evidence
flow.visual: The three people photograph their dishes. Camera flashes and upload taps send their three distinct photos into the app's Cooked Results section alongside the original concept. Show the I cooked it — add proof action as a controlled UI overlay.

flow.title: Brand and download
flow.visual: Food Felonies wordmark, chef mascot, warm paper and red download button.
flow.screen_text: Make it. Cook it. Show the evidence.

community_story: Nine fictional people react. Three featured reactors transition into their own kitchens, recreate the same recognizable dish, photograph their individual results, and upload them into the community's cooked-results section. Show visibly distinct results, no invented real-user testimonials or popularity figures.
